enDescription: Skip the photo studio. Upload a static image to Lovart and use Seedance 2.0 to generate stunning 4K product videos with cinematic camera sweeps in minutes.
strings: Turn Product Photos into 4K Videos with Seedance 2.0
Skip the photo studio. Upload a static image to Lovart and use Seedance 2.0 to generate stunning 4K product videos with cinematic camera sweeps in minutes.
Stop paying for turntable rentals, lighting equipment, and studio time. Generate professional-grade product spins and dynamic showcases directly from your laptop.
Whether it's the reflection of a glass perfume bottle or the fine grain of leather, Seedance 2.0 renders complex materials with hyper-realistic lighting and shadows.
Place your product on a sunlit beach, a marble kitchen counter, or a futuristic podium. Change backgrounds instantly to match seasonal marketing campaigns.
Achieve professional camera rig effects without the hardware. Generate silky-smooth pans, tilts, and dolly zooms to make your product the absolute center of attention.
Generate videos natively in 9:16 for TikTok/Reels, 1:1 squares for Instagram feeds, or 16:9 for traditional Amazon product pages without awkward cropping.
Worried about your product logo melting? Our fine-tuned models ensure that your brand's core identity, typography, and structural shape remain perfectly intact during motion.
Transform Product Photos into 4K Video Showcases with Seedance 2.0
E.g., A macro video showcase for a new glass perfume bottle on a marble counter...
From Static Image to Viral Video in 3 Steps
Upload a standard product photo. Lovart’s AI perfectly isolates your subject and prepares it for 3D-like video generation.
Use natural language to control the scene. Request a smooth 360-degree orbit, dynamic shadows, or a sunlit macro zoom.
Download your 4K video. Upload directly to Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop to immediately elevate your brand and increase conversions.

We used to spend $5,000 on a single commercial shoot for new product launches. Now, I upload an iPhone photo to Lovart, and Seedance 2.0 gives me a 4K 360-spin video that looks like it was shot in a Hollywood studio.
Adding an AI-generated video to our main listing increased our conversion rate by 34%. The way Lovart handles the lighting on our glass products is absolutely indistinguishable from real life.
The ability to generate the exact same product video in 16:9 for our website and 9:16 for our TikTok ads—without any quality loss—has saved our editing team countless hours.
Lovart is an AI Design Agent that turns briefs into on-brand visuals.
